nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Omar, you look happy! What happened?
It's a crazy story. Yesterday I lost my phone.
Oh no! Where did you lose it?
On the bus. I got off at my stop, and I left it on the seat. I didn't notice at first. Then I got home, and I put my hand in my pocket. Nothing!
First, I ran back to the bus stop, but of course the bus wasn't there. Then I called my number from my sister's phone. Nobody answered.
Did you call the bus company?
Yes, I did. A woman said, "Sorry, nobody has it." I felt terrible, and I went to bed very sad.

This morning, someone knocked on my door. It was a little boy with his mother. The boy had my phone in his hand! They found it on the bus yesterday, and they saw my address on a card in the phone case.
That's amazing! Did you give him anything?
Yes, I gave him ten dollars and a big bag of chocolates. He was very happy, and so was I!
